newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN BONDS AWAIT U.S. ELECTION RESULT.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN BONDS AWAIT U.S. ELECTION RESULT.

text.p: Belgian linear bond futures closed sharply higher on Tuesday but failed to set a new high as Bund futures did on the back of news about Russian president Yeltsin's successful heart operation.
Dealers said Wednesday's outlook depended entirely on the U.S. election result and the way Treasuries would react to that.
OLO futures ended 53 basis points higher at 119.58 but failed to break above their recent 119.82 high. Bund futures decisively broke through resistance at 100.
Dealers said OLOs lagged Bunds' advance because the German market is more influenced by events in Russia than Belgium is.

Belgian T-bill yields were virtually unchanged after the weekly auction where a high 180 billion francs was at expiry. Three-month bill yields closed at 3.05/07 percent, after bills were auctioned at 3.06 percent. A total 172 billion francs worth of three-, six- and 12-month paper was sold.

Money dealers said that the upward slope of the money yield curve -- six-month paper was sold at 3.09 percent, 12-month paper at 3.19 -- indicated expectations for rate hikes ahead. The BIBOR three-month forward yield was 10 bps above cash yields.
